title: Lānaʻi property appeal of planning director decision
summary: On September 10, 2026, the board unanimously approved moving the scheduling conference for an appeal of a planning director's decision about a Lānaʻi property to December 10th, 2026. The parties had agreed to the delay. The appeal was the first item taken up at that meeting.

timeline.text: The board approved the delay by unanimous consent.
The parties agreed to move its scheduling conference to December 10th, 2026.
The first item was an appeal of a planning director's decision about a Lānaʻi property.
